title: Tarn Icewind
summary: Power the portal, then destroy Tarn's crystals while controlling his reinforcements.
overview: Power the portal, then destroy Tarn's crystals while controlling his reinforcements.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare the raid before the fourth activation and assign crystal damage separately from the boss tank.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Turn in the required shard to each of the four portal crystals to summon Tarn.
Four attackable crystals replace the activation crystals. Defeating all four lowers Tarn's regeneration.
Tarn calls two reinforcements every minute during combat.
Ten minutes out of combat resets the portal event and removes the remaining attackable crystals.

notes: Approval E401. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
